processes:task-sd-build-intake-gnresv.business_purpose: It exists so the allocation is made over logged initiatives and envelopes rather than over informal budget promises.
processes:task-sd-build-intake-gnresv.practical_context: It opens when the initiatives and the envelopes are presented for allocation, with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered and the later phases free to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the strategy function logs the translated initiatives and their bounded envelopes into the allocating file, so the allocation work starts accounted for.

processes:task-sd-build-transform-xaa9vp.plain_language_name: Assign the Resources to Each Initiative Within Its Envelope
processes:task-sd-build-transform-xaa9vp.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the allocating proper begins. The processing custodian distributes people, funding and capacity to each initiative within its bounded envelope, producing the allocation in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-sd-build-transform-xaa9vp.business_purpose: It exists because an initiative without named resources is an aspiration, and one over its envelope is a future overrun.
processes:task-sd-build-transform-xaa9vp.practical_context: It opens when the verified material is ready to be worked, and it closes with the allocation produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function assigns funding and capacity to each verified initiative within its envelope, keeping the allocation workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-sd-build-verify-j95wg7.plain_language_name: Test the Initiatives and Envelopes Before Allocating Anything
processes:task-sd-build-verify-j95wg7.plain_language_description: Before any resource is assigned, the arriving initiative and envelope material is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-sd-build-verify-j95wg7.business_purpose: It exists because allocating against the wrong envelopes either strands initiatives unfunded or silently overspends them.
processes:task-sd-build-verify-j95wg7.practical_context: It opens once the intake is registered and the allocation material is ready to be challenged, and it closes with its shortfalls written down for rejection or putting right.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the strategy function tests the logged initiatives and envelopes against what the activity requires, and writes up an envelope that omits its running costs as a shortfall to be put right.

processes:task-sd-build-record-2ngq6a.plain_language_description: The filing work opens once confirmation is given. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so how each envelope was derived stays retrievable when spending limits are later contested.
processes:task-sd-build-record-2ngq6a.business_purpose: It exists so the arithmetic behind the envelopes survives as evidence through every budget challenge.
processes:task-sd-build-record-2ngq6a.practical_context: It opens when the confirmation is in place, and it closes with the bounding evidence filed at its required tier and the retrieval handles set.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in the strategy function files the bounding evidence at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so a contested envelope limit is explained from the record.

processes:task-sd-build-confirm-qmh9yq.plain_language_name: Hand the Bounded Envelopes to the Allocators
processes:task-sd-build-confirm-qmh9yq.plain_language_description: The confirming opens once the envelopes are bounded. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the bounded envelopes are available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised for the bounding.
processes:task-sd-build-confirm-qmh9yq.business_purpose: It exists so allocation and prioritisation work from confirmed envelopes rather than from figures still under negotiation.
processes:task-sd-build-confirm-qmh9yq.practical_context: It opens when the bounded envelopes are ready to hand on, and it closes with the confirmation issued and the bounding's promises checked off against what was delivered.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in the strategy function hands the bounded envelopes to the allocation team, reconciles them against what the bounding promised, and issues the confirmation.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the strategy function logs the translated initiatives and the strategic plan into the bounding file, so the envelope work starts accounted for.

The working papers are kept for the audit trail.

processes:task-sd-build-transform-mgnpp7.practical_context: It opens when the verified material is ready to be worked, and it closes with the bounded envelopes produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.
